title: Racing One Gravel Race Just Added Two Months to Evan Boyle’s Whereabouts Ban
content:
USADA says the 22-year-old American did not realize the Dust Bowl 100 was sanctioned. He now gets two extra months tacked onto his whereabouts ban.

Read the full article at Racing One Gravel Race Just Added Two Months to Evan Boyle’s Whereabouts Ban on Velo.
author: ahood
